About.title: Curiosity turned into solutions
About.story-1: It all started with a simple question: how does this work? Curiosity about what happens behind every product led me to programming. Since then, I have turned continuous learning into tools for building new things.
About.story-2: That drive has become real products: management systems that organize teamwork, tools that automate manual processes, and applications developed end to end, from data modeling to cloud deployment.
About.story-3: I hold a degree in Computer Science Engineering from the University of Informatics Sciences (UCI). I aim to create clear, maintainable, and useful software by combining sound technical decisions with a natural user experience.

Projects.title: Featured projects
Projects.description: Digital solutions that organize work and give businesses an online presence.

project1.description: A system for a direct sales client that brings products, customers, sales, and inventory together. Business logic connects each sale to available stock to keep operations traceable.
project1.highlight-1: Batch-level stock tracking and restoration on cancellation within transactions.
project1.highlight-2: Layered REST API, JWT authentication, and business-scoped data.
project1.summary: Sales and inventory for direct sales businesses.

project2.description: A task management application developed in a company environment. Its Kanban board makes work visible by status and lets users follow task progress from a single interface.
project2.highlight-1: Visual task organization through a Kanban board.
project2.highlight-2: Next.js and Tailwind CSS interface, with AWS as part of the stack.
project2.takeaway: Task management with a Kanban board.

project3.description: A web experience presenting the Valhalla bar and restaurant’s identity and opening hours. It combines a visual interface with a service layer that switches between mock data and API implementations without changing components.
project3.highlight-1: Motion carousel that respects reduced-motion preferences.
project3.highlight-2: Sections with loading states, error handling, and retries.
project3.summary: A bar and restaurant’s identity and opening hours.
project3.contribution: I handled the entire frontend, from experience and interface design to implementation and deployment on Vercel.

project4.description: A website for an architecture studio specializing in design and renders. An interactive gallery showcases its projects and lets visitors explore its work in Spanish and English.
project4.highlight-1: Gallery with interior and exterior filters and enlarged image previews.
project4.highlight-2: Language switching with React Context and contact through WhatsApp.
project4.summary: A web portfolio for an architecture studio.
project4.takeaway: Interactive gallery in Spanish and English.
project4.contribution: I contributed new sections, bug fixes, and deployment on Vercel to an existing project.

Experiencie.title: Professional experience
Experiencie.description: A career built through real products, remote collaboration, and end-to-end responsibility.

freelance.summary: I developed web solutions for clients and contributed to existing products, covering the process from requirements analysis to deployment.
freelance.achievement-1: I built Crisal, a system that brings products, customers, sales, and inventory together for a direct sales business.
freelance.achievement-2: I designed REST APIs with Node.js and Express, JWT authentication, and relational persistence with PostgreSQL.
freelance.achievement-3: For BK-Studio, I added sections, fixed issues, and contributed to deploying an existing codebase.

nimrod.summary: I worked as part of a remote team developing and maintaining business management products.
nimrod.achievement-1: I developed interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for a consistent management experience.
nimrod.achievement-2: I integrated REST APIs and managed global and asynchronous state with Redux, Zustand, and TanStack Query.
nimrod.achievement-3: I worked with AWS serverless services and contributed to architecture, code reviews, and testing for critical modules.
